note: This challenge is a Skill-authoring task, not a paper reproduction. Everything below is a LOCAL SELF-TEST on fixtures that ship inside this bundle (examples/input, a fictional molecular-pretraining paper; the Chinese fixture is generated by src/reproduce.py). It is NOT a result on the hidden official cases and must not be read as a benchmark score. Regenerate with `python3 src/reproduce.py`; the numbers come from execution/results/selftest_summary.json.

failure_modes.mode: invented citation (key absent from the library)
failure_modes.detection: resolve every \cite/@key/[n] against library.json and the manuscript reference list
failure_modes.recovery: drop the marker or replace it with a real key; never edit the library to fit the prose

failure_modes.detection: sentence matches numeric / literature-attribution / superlative signal but carries no citation and no author-judgment marker
failure_modes.recovery: add the citation or rewrite as 'we argue ...'

failure_modes.detection: run of >=3 consecutive paragraphs each citing one work with no comparative vocabulary, or 3 single-citation sentences inside a comparison-free paragraph
failure_modes.recovery: regroup and rewrite on one dimension per group

failure_modes.detection: every gap.derived_from ref must already be cited in the related-work part; kind=quote must occur verbatim in that reference's text
failure_modes.recovery: cite it first, then quote the limitation sentence as written

failure_modes.detection: figure/table/section/equation locator resolved against the manuscript index; result claims compared verbatim or by numeric set
failure_modes.recovery: point at a locator that exists, or cut the contribution

failure_modes.mode: number invented to smooth the prose
failure_modes.detection: every number carrying a unit or a decimal point must appear in the manuscript or a library abstract
failure_modes.recovery: restore the manuscript value; integers alone are NOT checked (documented blind spot)

failure_modes.detection: phrase list ('has attracted widespread attention', '随着……的快速发展', 'plays an important role', ...) plus paragraphs with >=2 claim sentences and no citation
failure_modes.recovery: replace with the concrete technical constraint

failure_modes.detection: library.json empty and no manuscript reference list
failure_modes.output: every citation unresolved -> R01 errors, state=partial, limits say 'library empty: citations unverifiable'
failure_modes.recovery: supply a bibliography; the skill does not invent one

failure_modes.mode: reference list numbered in discovery order instead of citation order
failure_modes.output: self-test check refs numbering aligned (this bug was found and fixed by it)
failure_modes.recovery: render the bibliography from the draft's own numbers

failure_modes.mode: run cut short by the budget
failure_modes.detection: plan writes a status=partial result.json before any model call
failure_modes.output: result.json with state=partial and the reason naming the next stage
failure_modes.recovery: resume with --stage audit / --stage finalize; all stages are idempotent

sensitivity.effect: adding bare comparative connectives (however / 相比之下) as triggers took the clean fixture from 0 to 6 false-positive warnings, so they were removed; the cost is that a comparison phrased without a number, an attribution verb or a superlative is not flagged

sensitivity.parameter: number scope for R13 (unit or decimal only)
sensitivity.effect: including bare integers produced false positives on list indices and section numbers; excluding them means integer-only fabrication is not caught
2 would flag ordinary two-paper paragraphs; 4 would miss the common three-work enumeration
looser (drop stopwords) raises false accepts; stricter (exact) fails on dash and full-width variants between PDF and BibTeX sources
lower links wrong references in numeric manuscripts and thus mis-numbers the bibliography; higher leaves real entries unmatched and marks them unverified
